My Journey with SVCE College:
College life is a transformative experience that shapes an individual in countless ways. From the first day of stepping
into campus to the moment of graduation, my journey with college has been a rollercoaster of emotions, challenges,
friendships, and growth. It was not just about academics but also about discovering myself, facing obstacles, and
creating unforgettable memories.
The Beginning: A New Chapter
Stepping into college was both exciting and nerve-wracking. The thrill of meeting new people, exploring an unfamiliar
environment, and gaining independence was overwhelming. At first, adapting to a new schedule and balancing academics
with social life seemed challenging. However, as days passed, I started finding my rhythm, making friends, and embracing
the new experiences that college had to offer.
Challenges and Growth
Like any journey, my college life had its fair share of hurdles. Managing deadlines, handling exam stress, and balancing
extracurricular activities tested my patience and time management skills. There were moments of self-doubt and
failures that made me question myself. However, these challenges became stepping stones to personal growth. I
learned resilience, problem-solving, and the importance of hard work. With the support of friends, professors, and
self-motivation, I transformed setbacks into lessons that shaped my character.
Memorable Moments and Friendships
Beyond academics, college was a hub of memories. Late-night study sessions, group projects, cultural festivals, and
spontaneous road trips made my journey special. Friendships formed during this time became my second family. The
laughter, the struggles, and the shared dreams brought us closer, making every moment cherishable. These experiences
taught me the value of teamwork, communication, and building lifelong connections.
My Suggestions to College Students
College is a transformative phase that brings new opportunities, challenges, and experiences. Based on my
journey, here are some key suggestions to help students make the most of their college life:
1. Manage Your Time Wisely:College life can be overwhelming with classes, assignments, exams, and
extracurricular activities. Create a schedule, prioritize tasks, and avoid procrastination to stay on top of
your responsibilities.
2. Step Out of Your Comfort Zone:Don’t be afraid to try new things — join clubs, participate in events,
and explore different interests. These experiences will help you discover your strengths and build
confidence.

Dr. A. Ganesh has his Research Contributions as:
Optimizing Task Scheduling: Exploring Advanced Machine Learning in DEW-Powered Cloud
Environments
 Dr. Ganesh conducted extensive research on machine learning algorithms for resource optimization
in fog and cloud computing. His work focused on enhancing task scheduling efficiency using
advanced AI strategies in DEW-computing architectures. (Published in Scalable Computing: Practice
and Experience)
Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Mirai Botnet Detection in IoT Devices
 He explored hybrid ML and DL models to detect cybersecurity threats in Internet of Things
environments. This work provided robust detection frameworks to mitigate botnet-driven intrusions.
(Presented at the Artificial Intelligence, Communication and Computational Technologies
Conference)
Biotechnology, Medicine and Cancer Therapeutics
 At the University of Alabama at Birmingham, Dr. Ganesh engaged in cross-disciplinary research
integrating machine learning techniques with biotechnology, targeting advancements in cancer
diagnosis and therapeutics.
A Deep Learning Approach for ECG-Based Cardiac Anomaly Detection with Improved Feature
Extraction
 He designed a deep learning model for real-time anomaly detection in ECG signals, enhancing early
diagnosis in cardiac patients using refined feature extraction methods. (Presented at the 2024 Global

A rally conducted on “Awareness of Cancer”
organized by department of computer science and
engineering. The main aim of this rally is to provide
awareness about “Say no to tobacco, say no to
cancer” students of all years participated in this
program conducted on 4th February 2025.
Students very actively participated in this rally
giving awareness to the people who are addicted
to tobacco.
 Cancer awareness is vital for promoting
prevention, early detection, and support for those
affected by cancer. It empowers individuals with
knowledge, fosters community support, and drives
advocacy for research and policy changes that can
lead to better outcomes for patients and their
families.
This rally is held from OTC near akkarampalli to
American bar near leelamahal. There are some
slogans given by students to bring awareness
“There is CAN in CANCER because we can BEAT it”.
Precautions to be taken to avoid cancer was
certain lifestyle choices and precautions can
significantly reduce the risk of developing the
disease. Here are some key precautions to
consider:
1. Healthy Diet
2.Regular physical Activity
3. Maintain a Healthy Weight
4.Avoid Tobacco
5. Limit Alcohol Consumption
By adopting these precautions and making
informed lifestyle choices, individuals can
significantly reduce their risk of developing cancer
and improve their overall health.

Engineers Day held on September 15th 2024.The department of computer science and engineering
students conducted a event called "DAZZLE CODING" and they also distributed prizes for runners and
winners. 
 Engineers Day is celebrated in honor of Sir Mokshagundam Visvesvaraya, a prominent Indian engineer,
scholar, and statesman who played a key role in the development of modern engineering in India. The

In CSP, recently we had the opportunity to
visit a school and conduct an awareness
program on childhood physical fitness. Our
main goal was to educate students about the
importance of staying physically active and
how it can benefit their overall health, growth,
and well-being. We divided the students into
two categories based on their age: under 10
years and above 10 years, so that we could
plan age-appropriate fitness activities for each
group.
For the under-10 age group, we organized fun
and playful activities like running races, simple
exercises, and games that encouraged
movement.After the activities, we gave small
gifts to all the participants to appreciate their
involvement and to motivate them to stay
active in their daily lives. We also spoke to
them about the importance of daily fitness
routines and encouraged them to continue
practicing the exercises we taught. We asked
them to promise to spend at least 30 minutes
every day doing physical activities.
